verdict.rationale: IRCC runs online application flows (GCKey accounts, online work-permit and Start-up Visa applications), so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence publishes operating hours, per-day submission limits, or session-timeout rules for those flows. The Start-up Visa June 30, 2026 cutoff is a program deadline, and the processing-time checker covers post-submission durations; neither addresses this story.
